opportunities.title: AFF (Accelerated Free Fall)
opportunities.summary: Accelerated freefall course: 6-7 hour ground school then seven level jumps from 14,000 ft, with two instructors on levels 1-3 and one on levels 4-7.
opportunities.prerequisites: "The minimum age is 16." No prior experience or tandem required.
opportunities.price_note: Ground school 350€ (materials, logbook, registration, insurance); levels 1-3 350€ per jump; levels 4-7 270€ per jump.

opportunities.title: AFF (Accelerated Free Fall)
opportunities.summary: AFF first jump with two instructors after a day-long ground school; student exits around 3,000 m and flies own canopy.
opportunities.prerequisites: Age 18+, a recent medical certificate, good physical condition, valid ID/passport; no scuba 24 h or alcohol 12 h before jumping.
opportunities.price_note: €390 for the first AFF jump (ground training included); later levels not priced.

opportunities.title: AFF Training
opportunities.summary: Accelerated freefall course: 6-7 hour ground school then seven level jumps from 14,000 ft, levels 1-3 with two instructors and 4-7 with one.
opportunities.prerequisites: "The minimum age is 16." No prior experience or tandem required.
opportunities.price_note: Ground school 350€; levels 1-3 350€ per jump; levels 4-7 270€ per jump; repeated levels charged again.

opportunities.title: Static Line
opportunities.summary: Static-line first jump from about 1,100 m with automatic canopy deployment, after a day-long ground school.
opportunities.prerequisites: Age 18+, a recent medical certificate, good physical condition, valid ID/passport.
opportunities.price_note: €220 for the first jump (ground training included).

opportunities.title: AFF Course
opportunities.summary: Individual AFF course at Ihtiman: about 6 hours of ground training and a test, then 7 jumps from 4,000 m (3 with two instructors, 4 with one), video-debriefed.
opportunities.price_note: €1,710; includes all gear (parachute, helmet, altimeter, goggles, radio).

opportunities.title: Instructor Assisted Deployment (IAD) and Static Line
opportunities.summary: Beginner progression starting with solo exits from about 1,100 m without freefall, focused on canopy flight; freefall introduced after jump 6.
opportunities.prerequisites: Age 18+ (or legal age), medical declaration, valid liability insurance; about 8 hours of ground school and an exam.

opportunities.title: License Package A
opportunities.summary: Post-AFF package at Ihtiman toward a USPA A licence: ground training plus 18 jumps (12 solo from 4,000 m, 1 solo from 1,500 m, 5 coach jumps), all video-recorded.
opportunities.prerequisites: Aimed at beginner skydivers seeking solo certification; USPA A requires 25 jumps and a written exam (as stated).

opportunities.title: SkyStarter AFF курс
opportunities.location_note: Training camp abroad; price listed for Spain
opportunities.summary: Bulgarian-organised individual AFF course held during a camp abroad: about 6 hours of ground training and 7 jumps from 4,000-4,500 m with video debriefs.
opportunities.prerequisites: Age 18+ (over 50 needs prior assessment), weight up to 100 kg, health declaration; listed medical contraindications.
opportunities.price_note: 1,990 € (Spain); includes training, 7 jumps, gear, video, insurance, logbook, T-shirt; travel and accommodation extra.

opportunities.title: Skydiving Course (AFF)
opportunities.summary: Seven-category AFF course with about 8 hours of ground school and an exam; first jump about 45 s freefall from roughly 3,500 m with two instructors.
opportunities.prerequisites: Age 18+ (or legal age for foreign citizens), medical declaration, valid third-party liability insurance; pass ground-school exam.

opportunities.title: Курс по скатаване (packing course)
opportunities.summary: Parachute packing course announced for November covering main steps, common pitfalls and speed tips for packing own and others' parachutes.

opportunities.title: Уингсют курс (wingsuit first-flight course)
opportunities.location_note: At the dropzone where the participant is jumping (not named)
opportunities.summary: First-flight wingsuit course with theory, ground training and three instructor-accompanied jumps with video and briefings/debriefings.
opportunities.prerequisites: At least 200 jumps with 100 in the past year (or 60 min freefall); logbook, liability insurance, valid licence; non-elliptical canopy under 1.3 wing loading; own first-flight wingsuit unless BSA member.

opportunities.title: Curso de Campana Marcos
opportunities.summary: Canopy course led by a coach named Marcos at Skydive Madrid, Lillo.

opportunities.title: LET event

opportunities.title: FAM Cats

opportunities.title: Maniacs

opportunities.title: Título A
opportunities.summary: Título A licence course after AFF: theory on equipment, formation technique and aircraft, plus jumps with an instructor.
opportunities.prerequisites: Si ya has hecho al menos 10 saltos de consolidación después de tu curso AFF

opportunities.title: A-TEAM
opportunities.summary: Two-day formation-flying training listed as 'Entrenamiento Básico' at Skydive Empuriabrava.

opportunities.title: Curso de Campana Marcos
opportunities.summary: December edition of the canopy course led by Marcos at Skydive Madrid, Lillo.

opportunities.title: FAM Cats
opportunities.summary: December date of the Madrid federation (FAM) 'Cats' formation-skydiving series.

opportunities.title: CHRISTMAS BOOGIE 2026
opportunities.summary: Multi-discipline Christmas boogie with FS, freefly and wingsuit load organisers, beach and balloon jumps, two Twin Otters and a Pilatus Porter.
opportunities.price_note: Registration fee (load organising not included): 80 EUR up to 14/11/2026, 95 EUR from 15/11/2026; load organising 4.80 EUR per jump; jump tickets separate. Max 250 participants.

opportunities.title: EASTER BOOGIE 2027
opportunities.summary: Five-day multi-discipline Easter boogie at Skydive Empuriabrava.

opportunities.title: 40-Way EURO RECORD CAMP by Joyriders
opportunities.summary: Three-day 40-way formation record-attempt camp run by Joyriders at Skydive Empuriabrava.

opportunities.title: Formation flights 36-WAYS with Angelo Declerck
opportunities.summary: Five-day advanced formation-flying training on 36-way formations with coach Angelo Declerck.

opportunities.title: Patrick Passe 40-WAY FORMATIONS
opportunities.summary: Five-day advanced formation-flying training on 40-way formations led by Patrick Passe.

opportunities.title: AFF Course (AFF 1.0 / Gold Package / Expert Package)
opportunities.summary: Accelerated Freefall training sold as AFF 1.0, a 7-day Gold package or a 10-14 day Expert package.
opportunities.prerequisites: Third Party Liability insurance is mandatory for AFF courses.
opportunities.price_note: Gold Package 7 Days 2,049 EUR; Expert Package 10-14 Days 3,478.50 EUR; AFF 1.0 684.50 EUR.

opportunities.title: AFF Course / AFF Plus Course
opportunities.summary: AFF course with ground school, an initial tandem jump and seven AFF levels; the Plus version adds 15 minutes of wind tunnel.
opportunities.prerequisites: Minimum age 16 (16-17 need notarised parental authorisation); sport fitness medical certificate mandatory.
opportunities.price_note: AFF COURSE 2099 EUR; AFF PLUS COURSE 2199 EUR; insurance from 80 EUR; low-season discount 4-6% October to May.

opportunities.title: AFF Residential Course
opportunities.summary: AFF course bundled with shared accommodation about 6 km from the dropzone, daily and Sevilla airport transfers, in 7- or 14-night options.
opportunities.price_note: 7-Night Residential + AFF Gold Package: '+ 429€'; 14-Night Residential + AFF Expert Package: '+ 808€' (add-ons on top of AFF price). Page text also mentions '379€ extra' for 14 days - inconsistent.

opportunities.title: Cursos PAC (Curso Básico / Clásico / Experto / Experto Plus de Caída Libre)
opportunities.summary: PAC/AFF freefall courses in several packages, from levels 1-7 only up to bundles with tandem, tunnel, Título A theory and extra jumps.
opportunities.prerequisites: Over 16 (minors need in-person parental/guardian authorisation and ID); basic medical certificate required by RFAE.
opportunities.price_note: Iniciación 710 EUR; Básico 1995 EUR; Clásico 2195 EUR; Experto 2995 EUR; Pack EXPERTO Plus 3995 EUR. Prices apply to Club members; 4% discount for cash/transfer; federation licence and reserve fee not included except as stated.

opportunities.title: Xmas Boogie 2026
opportunities.summary: Christmas boogie at Skydive Spain with Dornier G92 aircraft, daily videos and a team of load organisers; registration open.
opportunities.prerequisites: Minimum 100 jumps required to participate. You also must be licenced and current.

opportunities.title: Curso AFF Queda Livre Acelerada (QLA)
opportunities.summary: Accelerated freefall course at Évora: 6-8 hours of theory then 7 levels (levels 1-3 with two instructors, 4-7 with one), about 50 s freefall per jump.
opportunities.prerequisites: Sports medical exam (exame médico desportivo) required.
opportunities.price_note: Theory+L1 €590, L2-3 €275 each, L4 €195, L5-7 €165 each; extras sold separately (insurance €140, manual €30, logbook €25, goggles €25, etc.).

opportunities.title: Curso Queda Livre Assistida
opportunities.summary: Assisted (accelerated) freefall course sold by Skydive Porto; AFF jumps at Proença-a-Nova with theory classes in Braga.

opportunities.title: Curso de Abertura Automática (AA)
opportunities.summary: Static-line style course at Évora with 4 jumps from 1,200 m without freefall; landing guided by instructor via radio.
opportunities.prerequisites: Sports medical exam required.

opportunities.title: Curso de Dobragem
opportunities.summary: Packing course at Évora covering main canopy packing and equipment checks; stated as required for the A licence.

opportunities.title: Curso de Freefly (Vertical, Angle, Dynamic)
opportunities.summary: Coached freefly course at Évora per level (vertical, angle, dynamic) with 6 instructor slots, theory, briefings and video debriefs.
opportunities.prerequisites: For licence holders (no specific jump count stated).
opportunities.price_note: €625 per course plus 6-18 student slots per level depending on progress.

opportunities.title: Curso de Iniciação à Queda Livre
opportunities.summary: Introductory freefall course sold by Skydive Porto.

opportunities.title: Curso de Wingsuit
opportunities.summary: Coached wingsuit course at Évora with 6 instructor slots, theory, briefings and video debriefs.
opportunities.prerequisites: 200 jumps completed.
opportunities.price_note: €625 per course plus 6-12 student slots depending on progress.

opportunities.title: Iniciação à Queda Livre (IQL)
opportunities.summary: Introductory freefall course at Évora corresponding to the first level of the AFF programme.
opportunities.prerequisites: Sports medical exam required.

opportunities.title: Safety Day
opportunities.summary: Free safety day at Évora reviewing procedures, inspecting equipment and sharing techniques; open to all.

opportunities.title: Saltos Noturnos
opportunities.summary: Night jumps at Évora from 12,500 ft (first-timers from 5,000 ft) with an 18:30 briefing; count toward D licence night-jump requirement.
opportunities.prerequisites: B licence or higher; jumping regularly at the DZ or two familiarisation jumps on the day or day before; attend 18:30 briefing; illuminated altimeter.

opportunities.title: Voo de Asa (Estágio de Voo de Asa)
opportunities.summary: Two-day canopy flight course at Évora with basic and advanced levels and optional water-landing training in a pool.
opportunities.prerequisites: Licence holders; levels tied to licence (Level 1 for Licence B, Level 2 for Licence C).
opportunities.price_note: €150 for 2-day course, +€50 water training. Course page footnote also gives €250 (1 person) / €200 each (2) / €150 each (3+); jumps extra (slot €42, rental €15, packing €8).
